2607.25612.title: Multi-Sensor Alignment for Weather Simulations
2607.25612.paper_summary: Perception tasks for autonomous vehicles need to work satisfactorily in adverse weather conditions. Due to lack of real-world weather datasets, weather simulations are a promising alternative. To ensure simulations closely mirror real-world weather data, it's crucial that they represent the same weather characteristics, including severity and particle positioning, across different sensors. To achieve this, we propose the Reference Dataset Alignment Method (ReDAM) for weather intensity alignment in fog and Unified-weather-edit (inspired by Weather-edit[1]) for particle positioning alignment in rain and snow. We validate both alignment methods using statistical and geometrical tests, respectively. We find that 3D detection models for non-aligned versions tend to be overly optimistic as compared to aligned versions. We also show the aligned-multi-sensor simulation's effectiveness for achieving robustness for 3D object detection task by finetuning existing sensor fusion models on it.
2607.25612.paper_summary_zh: 自動駕駛車輛的感知任務需要在不利的天氣條件下正常運作。由於缺乏現實世界的天氣數據集，天氣模擬成為一個有希望的替代方案。為了確保模擬能夠緊密反映現實世界的天氣數據，至關重要的是，它們必須在不同的傳感器之間代表相同的天氣特徵，包括嚴重程度和顆粒位置。為此，我們提出了參考數據集對齊方法（ReDAM）用於霧中的天氣強度對齊，以及統一天氣編輯（受Weather-edit[1]啟發）用於雨雪中的顆粒位置對齊。我們分別使用統計和幾何測試來驗證這兩種對齊方法。我們發現，與對齊版本相比，非對齊版本的3D檢測模型往往過於樂觀。我們還展示了對齊的多傳感器模擬在通過對其進行微調現有的傳感器融合模型來實現3D物體檢測任務的穩健性方面的有效性。
